decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01-01, received on 06/12/2012 and 02-02 and 03-01, received on 01/02/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - If any bubbling of the masonry paint applied to the basement walls appears, it shall be scraped back to remove the impermeable paint and a lime wash shall be applied in its place.

Condition : 4 - A report describing the condition of the basement walls one year after the date of this permission, including details of any works carried out as required by condition 3, and the current state of the wall at that time shall be submitted to the local planning authority no later than 14 months after the date of this permission.  The submission shall include a proposal for remedial measures to prevent further blistering of the paint if any has occurred which shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval and shall thereafter be carried out as approved within one year of the date of such approval.
Condition : 5 - No ceiling joists shall be painted within the basement unless prior approval has been granted in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 6 - When the premises cease to be occupied by Mr Michael Wright of Oakhill Estate Agents, the existing ceiling structure and lighting arrangement in the front and rear room shall be removed and shall be replaced before the next occupier commences business operations from the property or otherwise makes use of the property in accordance with a scheme that shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. through the submission of an application for Listed Building consent
Condition : 7 - No alterations shall be carried out to the existing lighting arrangement, without prior consent from the local planning authority.
description: Listed building consent for the retention of the existing replacement ceiling in the front and rear rooms, installation of lighting, painting of basement walls, repair of internal walls in the front and rear rooms with gypsum plaster, installation of a fire door, removal and alterations to dresser units and associated works and the proposed installation of skirting boards.
